notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional permanent.
description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Biotransference.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
